mapper.select: SELECT fp.id, fp.title, fp.content, fp.user_id, u.username, u.avatar, fp.scenic_id, fp.route_id, fp.view_count, fp.reply_count, fp.is_top, fp.is_essence, fp.is_audit, fp.create_time FROM forum_post fp LEFT JOIN user u ON fp.user_id = u.id WHERE fp.id = #{id} AND fp.deleted = 0

SELECT fp.id, fp.title, fp.content, fp.user_id, u.username, u.avatar, fp.scenic_id, fp.route_id, fp.view_count, fp.reply_count, fp.is_top, fp.is_essence, fp.is_audit, fp.create_time FROM forum_post fp LEFT JOIN user u ON fp.user_id = u.id WHERE fp.deleted = 0 AND fp.is_audit = 1 ORDER BY fp.view_count DESC, fp.reply_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
